# Vita3KiOS game fixes
#
# Recommended settings per game. The app downloads this file when the library opens and applies a
# game's line when it starts, unless the player has given that game settings of their own.
# Edit it on GitHub: everyone gets the change the next time they open the app, no new build needed.
#
# One line per game:   TITLE_ID  setting=value  setting=value  | note shown in the game's settings
#
# Settings: memory-mapping, surface-sync, high-accuracy, async-shaders, texture-cache, shader-cache,
#           fps-hack, cpu-opt, v-sync, stretch, fast-cpu (on/off), resolution (0.5 to 4), screen-filter
#           (Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FXAA)
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

# Gravity Rush (US, EU): without surface sync the bloom builds up and scenes are far too bright
PCSA00011 surface-sync=on | Surface sync on: fixes the over-bright bloom (Vita3K/compatibility#177)
PCSF00024 surface-sync=on | Surface sync on: fixes the over-bright bloom (Vita3K/compatibility#177)

# Persona 4 Golden (US, EU): vertex spikes in 3D scenes with GPU memory mapping
PCSE00120 memory-mapping=off | GPU memory mapping off: removes the spikes in 3D scenes
PCSB00245 memory-mapping=off | GPU memory mapping off: removes the spikes in 3D scenes

# Madden NFL 13: players are skinned on the GPU (needs memory mapping); surface sync crashed it at
# boot or blacked out the field; shaders compiled before drawing so nothing goes missing
PCSE00084 memory-mapping=on surface-sync=off async-shaders=on fast-cpu=off | Memory mapping on (faces and bodies), surface sync off (black field, crash), background shaders on (with them off the GPU hung and the phone froze), Fast CPU off
